summary: PBF Energy Inc. via its subsidiary PBF Holding Company LLC issued $500M of 7.250% senior notes due 2034 in a private placement under Rule 144A/Regulation S, netting ~$492.7M after discounts and expenses. Proceeds and available cash will redeem outstanding 6.00% senior unsecured notes due 2028. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by several subsidiaries and rank equally with existing indebtedness. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
